title: Legacy RESTRICT_EDIT_OF_PART_SELL_PRICE migrated to positive-grant
preconds: Build with CRP-FE-02 deployed. Pre-migration baseline.
steps:
1. Identify a user who had RESTRICT_EDIT_OF_PART_SELL_PRICE pre-migration.
2. Confirm their new role configuration achieves the same effect via positive-grant semantics (likely PART_SALES_EDIT off, or seeFinancialData off — depends on tech plan implementation).
3. Log in as user. Try to edit a part's sell price.
expected: User cannot edit part sell price. Legacy restriction preserved via positive-grant semantics.
